probes.name: export_standard
probes.macro:
Function Probe() As String
Dim target As Workbook, project As Object, parts As Object
Dim part As Object, item As Object, code As Object, number As Long, extra As String
Dim inputPath As String, outputPath As String
Application.EnableEvents = False
Application.DisplayAlerts = False
Set target = Workbooks.Add
Set project = target.VBProject
Set parts = project.VBComponents
inputPath = "INPUT"
outputPath = "OUTPUT"
Set part = parts.Add(1)
part.Name = "Source"
part.CodeModule.AddFromString "Option Explicit" & vbCrLf & "Public Marker As Long" & vbCrLf & "" & vbCrLf & "Public Function Answer() As Long" & vbCrLf & "Answer = 42" & vbCrLf & "End Function"
On Error Resume Next
part.Export outputPath
number = Err.Number
On Error GoTo 0
Probe = "#error:" & CStr(number) & "#extra:" & extra
For Each item In parts
Probe = Probe & "|" & item.Name & ":" & CStr(item.Type) & ":" & CStr(item.CodeModule.CountOfLines)
Next
If Not part Is Nothing Then
Set code = part.CodeModule
Probe = Probe & "#part:" & part.Name & "#decl:" & CStr(code.CountOfDeclarationLines)
If code.CountOfLines > 0 Then Probe = Probe & "#source:" & code.Lines(1, code.CountOfLines)
End If
Probe = Probe & "#saved:" & CStr(target.Saved)
target.Close False
End Function
